name: gamenet_update_remote_player_hud_widget_screen_pos
description: GameNet::UpdateRemotePlayerHudWidgetScreenPos projects a remote player's name-tag panel, hides it for disabled tags, blocked/clipped/top-margin cases, and shows it at the projected screen position otherwise.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly inspection in the current session verified the fastcall save-state ABI, no-op return when name tags are disabled, use of saveState->playerState->worldPos plus a 3.0 y offset, line-of-sight gating through AINet::HasLineOfSightFromLocalPlayerFxOffset(rootNode, point, 1), projection through zMath::ProjectPointAndClampToScreenClip, replicate-mode x/y doubling before integer conversion, y -= 10, top-margin hide when y <= QueryTextHeight() + 26, clipped-point hide, and final SetPos/SetVisible calls. Slot offsets are ABI evidence only; production source now uses typed panel methods.
The native smoke checks disabled name-tags no-op, visible position at normal scale, visible position under replicate scaling, top-margin hide, and clipped-point hide.

Binary Ninja still carries a limited reconstruction marker because of x87 ftol conversion shape; no VC manifest covers 0x432d60 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a GameNet/HUD source-cluster pass.
